"APP POLICY AND GUIDELINES

Campsite Lottery Reservation App
Last updated: November 2026

By using this app, you agree to the policies and guidelines below. They apply to every user: entrants, campsite owners, and administrators. Please read them carefully.

1. PURPOSE OF THE APP
This app helps people reserve popular campsites in Alberta fairly. Instead of rewarding whoever refreshes a webpage fastest, campsite owners open a lottery. Entrants join a waiting list during a registration period, and winners are drawn at random once it ends. Winners are then given a booking period to reserve available dates. The aim is accessibility and fairness for people with work, disability, or other limitations.

2. USER ROLES
Entrant: a person who, on behalf of a group, declares interest in reserving a campsite.
Campsite Owner: a person or organization that creates and manages campsite listings and lotteries.
Administrator: a person who moderates the app and its content.
One person may hold more than one role. An administrator may also act as an entrant and/or a campsite owner using the same profile. Each role has only the privileges needed for its tasks.

3. IDENTIFICATION AND PROFILES
3.1 The app identifies you by your device, so no username or password is required. Your profile is linked to that device.
3.2 Your profile may include your name, email address, phone number, and an optional profile image. Please provide accurate information.
3.3 You may update your personal information or add, change, or remove your profile image at any time.
3.4 You may delete your profile at any time. Deleting it removes your profile information, your profile image, and your waiting list entries. Some records, such as past reservations, may be kept where the other party needs them or where required to operate the app, but they will no longer be linked to your personal profile where possible.
3.5 Because your profile is tied to your device, clearing the app data, resetting the device, or using a different device may mean you no longer have access to your existing profile.
3.6 You are responsible for activity that happens on your device through the app.

4. SEARCHING AND VIEWING CAMPSITES
4.1 Entrants may search for campsites and filter them by location, date, and number of guests.
4.2 Each listing shows summary information (name, location, maximum occupancy, and rating) and a details screen (description, amenities, price, rules, cancellation policy, availability, images, ratings, and map location).
4.3 Campsite owners are responsible for the accuracy of their listings. Availability and information may change, and a listing is not a guarantee of a reservation.

5. QR CODES
5.1 Each campsite has a unique QR code that links to its details. Scanning it lets you view the listing and, if a lottery is active, join its waiting list.
5.2 Owners may share their QR codes on posters, websites, and social media. Do not alter QR codes or use them to mislead others.
5.3 Only scan QR codes from sources you trust. The app is not responsible for content on external materials where a code is displayed.

6. THE LOTTERY SYSTEM
6.1 Joining the waiting list: Entrants may join the waiting list of an active lottery during its registration period. Joining does not guarantee a reservation. An owner may set a maximum capacity for the waiting list, and once it is full, no more entrants can join.
6.2 Leaving the waiting list: You may leave a waiting list at any time before the draw.
6.3 The draw: After the registration period ends, the system automatically draws the number of winners set by the owner. Selection is random, and all entrants on the waiting list have an equal chance. Owners cannot choose or influence who wins.
6.4 Notifications: Entrants are notified whether they won or lost. Notifications appear within the app.
6.5 Multiple campsites: An owner may include several campsites in one lottery, and owners may combine their campsites in a shared lottery. If you win such a lottery, you choose which campsite and which dates to reserve from those still available.
6.6 Joining several lotteries: You may join as many lotteries as you like. Winning more than one does not oblige you to reserve all of them.
6.7 Fair use: Do not use multiple profiles, devices, or any other method to gain an unfair advantage in a lottery. Doing so may lead to removal of your entries or profiles.

7. BOOKING AFTER WINNING
7.1 A winner has a limited booking period set by the owner. Dates still available are shown, and you select the campsite (if more than one), the dates, and the number of guests.
7.2 The number of guests must not exceed the campsite's maximum occupancy.
7.3 Before confirming a reservation, you must confirm that you have read the campsite's rules and cancellation policy.
7.4 Dates are checked again at the moment of booking. If dates were booked by someone else, they can no longer be reserved.
7.5 You may decline your chance to reserve if you changed your mind or if none of the remaining dates work for you. Declining is free of penalty.
7.6 If the booking period ends without you reserving, the opportunity may expire.

8. RESERVATIONS
8.1 You will receive confirmation of each reservation by in-app notification, and you may also download a CSV file of your confirmation.
8.2 You can view your active, past, and cancelled or rejected reservations in the app.
8.3 Reservations are for the campsite, dates, and number of guests shown at confirmation. You must follow the campsite's rules during your stay.

9. CANCELLATIONS, REJECTIONS, AND REFUNDS
9.1 Entrant cancellations: You may cancel an active reservation. The dates then become available again. You will receive confirmation by notification or CSV file.
9.2 Cancellation policies: Each campsite sets its own cancellation policy, which is shown before you reserve. Any refund depends on that policy and on the timing of your cancellation.
9.3 Owner rejections: An owner may reject a reservation for reasons such as safety concerns, wildfire or severe weather warnings, closures, maintenance, or emergencies. When this happens, the reservation is marked as rejected, the dates are freed, you are notified, and your refund status is recorded in the app.
9.4 Owners must not reject reservations for discriminatory or unfair reasons.
9.5 Refund status is shown for each cancelled or rejected reservation. Refunds follow the applicable cancellation policy and, for owner rejections, are intended to be provided in full.

10. CAMPSITE OWNER RESPONSIBILITIES
10.1 Owners must provide truthful and complete information, including name, location, description and amenities, maximum occupancy, price, tags, map location, rules, and cancellation policy.
10.2 Owners must keep their listings, availability, and lotteries up to date, and must not list a campsite they do not have the right to offer.
10.3 Owners may set the registration period, booking period, number of winners, and an optional waiting list capacity. Lottery details may be updated, but owners should not make changes that unfairly disadvantage entrants who have already joined.
10.4 Owners may view their campsites, booked dates, active, past, and cancelled reservations, and the waiting list of entrants for their lotteries.
10.5 Owners must honour confirmed reservations except in genuine circumstances such as those listed in section 9.3.
10.6 Owners may send notifications to entrants on their lottery waiting lists and may view a record of all notifications they have sent. Notifications must relate to the lottery or campsite and must not be misleading or promotional spam.
10.7 Owners may message users who are reserving their campsite. Messages must relate to the reservation.
10.8 Owners must keep entrants' personal information confidential and use it only to manage reservations.

11. IMAGES
11.1 Owners may upload promotional images of their campsites, and entrants may upload a profile image.
11.2 You may only upload images you own or have permission to use.
11.3 Images must not contain nudity, violence, hateful or offensive content, personal information of others, or anything illegal or misleading.
11.4 Promotional images must fairly represent the campsite.
11.5 Administrators may remove any image that violates this policy.

12. LOCATION INFORMATION
12.1 Owners attach a map location to each campsite, and entrants can view it on a map.
12.2 Owners must provide an accurate location. The location is public to all users of the app.

13. RATINGS AND REVIEWS
13.1 Entrants may give a rating and post a review for a campsite.
13.2 Ratings and reviews must be honest, based on your own experience, and relevant to the campsite.
13.3 Reviews must not contain harassment, hate speech, personal attacks, private information, spam, or false statements.
13.4 Owners must not post fake reviews or pressure entrants to change them.
13.5 Administrators may remove ratings and reviews that violate this policy.

14. MESSAGING AND NOTIFICATIONS
14.1 Owners and entrants may exchange messages about a reservation. Messages must be respectful and related to the reservation.
14.2 Do not use messaging to harass, threaten, scam, or send unsolicited advertising.
14.3 Entrants may opt out of receiving notifications in their profile settings. If you opt out, you may miss important information such as lottery results and booking deadlines. You are responsible for checking the app for time-sensitive opportunities.
14.4 Notifications and messages may be logged and reviewed by administrators to enforce this policy and to resolve disputes.

15. PROHIBITED CONDUCT
You must not:
- Provide false, misleading, or fraudulent information.
- Impersonate another person or organization.
- Manipulate or attempt to manipulate lottery results.
- Create multiple profiles to gain an advantage.
- Harass, threaten, or discriminate against other users.
- Upload illegal, offensive, or infringing content.
- Attempt to access data or features you are not authorized to use.
- Interfere with the operation or security of the app.
- Use the app for any unlawful purpose.

16. ADMINISTRATOR ROLE AND MODERATION
16.1 Administrators moderate the app to keep it safe and fair.
16.2 Administrators may browse campsites, profiles, and uploaded images, and may review logs of notifications and of messages between owners and entrants.
16.3 Administrators may remove campsites, profiles, images, ratings, and reviews that violate this policy, and may remove campsite owners who repeatedly or seriously violate it.
16.4 Administrators must use their access only for moderation and operation of the app, and must keep any personal information they see confidential.
16.5 An administrator may also use the app as an entrant or owner, and is subject to the same rules as everyone else in those roles.

17. PRIVACY AND DATA
17.1 The app stores your information, such as profile details, campsite listings, lottery entries, reservations, notifications, and messages, using Google Firebase services.
17.2 We collect only the information needed to operate the app. Your name, email, and phone number are used to manage lotteries and reservations and are shared with an owner only where needed for a reservation you are involved in.
17.3 Your information is not sold to third parties.
17.4 Data is updated in real time so that lottery and reservation statuses stay current.
17.5 You may view, update, and delete your personal information in your profile.
17.6 Reasonable steps are taken to protect your data, but no system is completely secure.

18. ACCESSIBILITY
We want this app to be usable by everyone. If you experience difficulty using any part of the app, please let us know so we can improve it.

19. AVAILABILITY AND LIABILITY
19.1 The app is provided as is, without a guarantee that it will always be available or error free.
19.2 The app helps connect entrants and owners. The reservation is an arrangement between the entrant and the campsite owner. The app is not responsible for the condition, safety, or conduct of any campsite, owner, or guest.
19.3 Campsite conditions, wildfire, weather, and park closures can change quickly. Always check official sources, such as Parks Canada and Alberta Parks, before you travel.
19.4 To the extent permitted by law, the app and its developers are not liable for losses arising from use of the app, including missed lottery opportunities or changes to reservations.

20. ENFORCEMENT
Violations of this policy may result in a warning, removal of content, removal of lottery entries or reservations, or removal of a profile or campsite owner account. Serious violations may be reported to the appropriate authorities.

21. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
This policy may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated policy. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.

22. CONTACT
For questions or concerns about this policy, or to report a violation, please contact the app administrators through the app."
